sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Single import point for schema tables
sections.what: Passes along every table and type from the main schema, opportunity and evidence files, so the database code can import them all from one place.
sections.why: Likely reason: one import point keeps other code simpler. The code does not state this directly.
sections.watch_out: If two of the three files export the same name, the clash will cause an error. The long template comment at the top is not about this project.

summary: Gathers the exports from the main, opportunity and evidence schema files into one import point.
purpose: Lets other code import any table from one place instead of three.
why: Likely reason: one import point keeps other files simple. The code does not state this directly.
how: It re-exports everything from the main schema file, then from the opportunity file, then from the evidence file. Nothing else happens in this file.
inputs: None. It only reads the three files it re-exports.
outputs: A combined set of table definitions and types.
risks: If two of the three files export a name that is the same, one will clash with the other. The top of the file is leftover template text.
debug: If a table cannot be found when imported, check that the file defining it is re-exported here.
